desc:
TIKTOK POLICE PRISON RUN! (Obby)

You’ve been locked inside a high-security TikTok prison, and the guards are watching every move.

Race through obstacle-filled cell blocks, avoid dangerous traps, and find your way out before the TikTok guard catches you. Use helpful items along the way to survive each stage and reach freedom.

Challenge the obby alone or escape with friends while trying to set your fastest time.

Will you make it out of the TikTok prison?
